title: World Bank — Principles for Effective Insolvency and Creditor/Debtor Regimes (Revised 2021)
use: Policy benchmark for distinguishing commencement tests, specifying claim priorities and new financing, and facilitating informed consensual workouts. Numerical waterfalls and all contract terms in this chapter are original fictional assumptions, not assertions of applicable law.
verification: Actual official 44-page PDF inspected at principles B3–B4 (printed pages 19–20), C4 (22), C9 (24), C12 (26) and C14 (27). Recommendations use should-language and do not establish any jurisdiction’s current rules. Source scope excludes broad adoption/compliance or legal-opinion claims.

title: OECD — G20/OECD Principles of Corporate Governance 2023, V. The responsibilities of the board
use: Dated governance recommendations on informed review, risk oversight, conflicts of interest, independent judgement and disclosure; supports the chapter’s proposed decision process rather than a universal fiduciary rule.
verification: Actual official HTML body inspected at V.A, V.D.1–2, V.D.7–9 and V.E.1, including jurisdictional variation. The chapter does not import a business-judgement safe harbour, director-liability threshold or current statutory duty.

title: OECD — G20/OECD Principles of Corporate Governance 2023, About the Principles
use: Explicitly identifies the Principles as non-binding recommendations that do not replace domestic law, delimiting the board-process reference.
verification: Official HTML opened and its non-binding-status passage retrieved through find. This narrow verification does not claim review of every provision. Attempted Gertner/Scharfstein NBER and author-hosted routes were unavailable; no unsupported full-text claim or citation to that paper is included.
